faqs.a: Sanctify is an award-winning digital marketing group founded in Goa in 2012. It operates a family of properties — the Sanctify Goa agency (sanctify.in), the Sanctify.biz local-SEO engine, Sanctify Hostings (sanctify.co.in) and the Goa Guru local portal — offering web design, SEO, advertising, social media and branding.

faqs.q: What services does the Sanctify group offer?
faqs.a: The group offers digital marketing, search engine optimization (SEO), Google Ads and paid advertising, social media marketing, web design and development, content marketing, branding and creative, and web hosting.

faqs.q: Where is Sanctify based and which areas does it serve?
faqs.a: Sanctify is headquartered in Vasco-da-Gama, Goa, India, and serves businesses across North and South Goa and beyond, including Panjim, Calangute, Mapusa, Margao and other towns.
Sanctify has 13+ years of experience (since 2012), has grown 100+ brands, and holds a 4.8/5 rating across 128 client reviews.

faqs.q: How do I get in touch with Sanctify?
faqs.a: You can reach Sanctify by phone at +91-9923352923, on WhatsApp, or by email at business@sanctify.biz. The team responds within one working day.
